metadata.title: Vintage Wedding Collage with Vertical Gold Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A multi-layered photomontage of mid-century wedding portraits featuring vertical, gold-textured sans-serif typography centered over the collage seams.
excludeWhen: vibrant or neon color palettes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, overlapping grid of black-and-white and sepia-toned wedding photographs from the mid-20th century, unified by a grainy texture and a central vertical typographic element in a metallic gold finish.
coreVisualRelationships: Overlapping photographic layers create a sense of depth and history.
Vertical text acts as a central spine, bridging disparate image panels.
High-contrast gold typography pops against the muted, desaturated background.
Grainy, low-fidelity photo quality provides a consistent vintage atmosphere.
coreInvariants: Vertical orientation of all text characters.
Muted sepia and grayscale color palette for imagery.
Visible seams and overlapping edges between photographic elements.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Multiple subjects in various scales; the primary wedding couple is positioned top-left, while smaller portraits fill the remaining quadrants.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical gold text located slightly right of the center serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright white of the central bride's dress, moves to the gold text, and then circulates through the surrounding smaller portraits.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is a 'horror vacui' style collage with very little empty space.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and sepia tones provide the base for the collage.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white and cream highlights within the wedding attire create tonal range.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic gold is used exclusively for the typography to denote importance.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation across the board with high value contrast in the central figures.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to sepia, black, white, and gold

characterSpecificRedesigns: Characters are rotated 90 degrees clockwise to read vertically while maintaining their upright orientation.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in two vertical columns to create a balanced block of text.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, mid-century aesthetic of the era.
Provides the necessary weight and clean lines for the gold texture.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a collage of 5-7 vintage 1950s wedding photos in sepia and black-and-white. Overlap the images with visible seams and apply a heavy film grain and dust texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place two columns of uppercase sans-serif text vertically in the center-right. Apply a distressed gold foil texture to the letters and a very subtle outer glow to separate them from the dark background.

verificationChecks: Does the text have a metallic gold texture?
Are the background images desaturated and grainy?
Is the layout a collage of multiple photos?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no modern objects in photos
Confirm grainy texture is applied globally
Check that text is legible against the collage
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Photomontage + Vertical Geometric Typography + Gold Foil Accent
